title: promotions.codes.revoke
description: Withdraw one issued code (e.g. a reversed referral reward), by code text (case-insensitive) or code_id. From then on validate, quote and reserve refuse it with error.409.promo_code_revoked; redemptions already committed are untouched. Idempotent: revoking a revoked code changes nothing and answers the same (the first reason is kept). Output: {code, code_id, revoked: true, already_revoked: bool, redeemed: bool (the code has committed redemptions), revoked_at}. An unknown code fails the call.
